id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a motherduck sync that hits an out of memory wall

review.posthog_relevance: Adds MotherDuck warehouse connector error handling and test coverage for distinguishing remote OOM errors, supporting warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.reason: Adds a MotherDuck warehouse connector error entry and a corresponding test. This is a bounded, substantive improvement to warehouse ingestion reliability and user-facing diagnostics, not a systemic architectural change.
review.uncertainty: This chunk lacks the implementation of the classification change, so the tier is assigned based on the visible error mapping and test, not the full classification behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the classification change, only the error message mapping and a test. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error message entry for 'duckling size' OOM, distinguishing it from local worker OOM.
observations.posthog_connection: This entry allows the MotherDuck warehouse connector to recognize a specific OOM error and provide a user-facing message suggesting increasing the duckling size, rather than treating it as a transient retryable error.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case distinguishing between OOM errors originating from the remote MotherDuck compute instance versus the local worker.
observations.posthog_connection: This entry allows the MotherDuck warehouse connector to recognize a specific OOM error and provide a user-facing message suggesting increasing the duckling size, rather than treating it as a transient retryable error.
